Report each hit as file:line and say precisely what `/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-92/c2-contract.md` duplicates, extends or contradicts. Name the one place where `scripts/stored_reuse.py` returns `heuristic-undecided` and quote its lines: the new instrument must compose with that decision, not re-decide it.

(2) Name the exact insertion points for the round's corpus work: which `corpus/README.md` section takes the round-92 frontier paragraph (quote the last section heading and its line number), which `SKILL.md` table takes registry rows (quote two existing rows for format), and where `SCORECARD.md` carries the "Planned — after round 91" section (line number) so the L1 can append after it.

(3) Read LANE/corpus/QUALITY.md and list, with criterion ids and line numbers, the criteria a new instrument and a new knowledge entry must satisfy this round.

ScoutSources.item:
Open this round's source yourself (CORPUS.md rule 1: a row is written only after its source is opened this round).

(1) GET https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9111.txt with curl. Record the HTTP status, byte count, sha256 and the UTC access time in your directory. Compare it byte-for-byte with LANE/.ufo/waves/round-92/L1/src/rfc9111.txt (frozen sha256 aeb52adb3279d5f23dae34f68af11bd5cef0a0aff7ffcd014c9ca93c5302cf3e) and say identical or list the first difference.

(2) From the fetched body, quote with plain-text line numbers and exact bytes, each 3-25 words: (a) the sentence that lets a cache assign a heuristic expiration time when no explicit time is specified; (b) the sentence that forbids heuristics when an explicit expiration time is present; (c) the sentence naming which responses may use heuristics (status codes / explicit cacheability); (d) the sentence on the fraction of the interval since Last-Modified and the 10% figure. For each, give the line numbers and the quote.

(3) Check https://www.rfc-editor.org/errata/rfc9111 and https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc9111/ once each: report whether any erratum or obsoletion touches §4.2.2, with the erratum id and its status if one does.

(4) Say which of the contract's two conventions (the 10% fraction, the 86400 cap) the RFC text actually supports and which it does not, quoting the text.

Deliverable: `/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-92/w1/ScoutSources/Sources.md` with a receipt table (URL, HTTP, bytes, sha256, UTC time) and the quotes, plus `/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-92/w1/ScoutSources/rfc9111-fetched.txt`.

ExecHeuristic.item:
Implement the C2 capability: LANE/scripts/heuristic_freshness.py, exactly per LANE/.ufo/waves/round-92/c2-contract.md (clauses 1-13). Stdlib only. One JSON object on stdin, one JSON object on stdout with exactly the keys `decision`, `lifetime`, `heuristic`; refusal is `invalid_input: <reason>` on stderr with exit 1 and nothing on stdout. It must also support `--selftest` running its own in-memory fixtures (no files written outside TMPDIR) and printing a final `selftest K/K` line.

The contract's two lane conventions (the 10% fraction and the 86400 cap) must be named as conventions in the tool's module docstring, not presented as RFC requirements. Do not re-implement the Cache-Control directive grammar if `scripts/cache_control_effective.py` already exposes a reader you can import — read it first and say in your report whether composition was possible and why you did or did not use it (the round-91 routed defect R91-4 asks for composition; do not duplicate a reader silently).

Develop in a scratch clone: S=/fast/scratch/hyaku/kake-r92/ExecHeuristic; `git clone -q --shared /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin $S/clone`; `git -C $S/clone checkout -q --detach a5640ca02c20f94a0fa03af41b977b46ae99808e`; write the tool in the clone, commit it there with a fixture identity, then run the frozen counter against the clone:
  python3 -B /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-92/c92_heuristic.py --root $S/clone --revision $(git -C $S/clone rev-parse HEAD) --work $S/work
Iterate until it reads `hand=28/28 generated=120/120 forgeries_refused=5/5 anti_table=ok population=ok met=true` exit 0. Then copy the final tool to LANE/scripts/heuristic_freshness.py (that path only) and copy the counter run and `--selftest` output into your directory.

Deliverable: LANE/scripts/heuristic_freshness.py plus `/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-92/w1/ExecHeuristic/{counter.txt,selftest.txt,Notes.md}`.

ExecMutation.item:

It must (a) for `base` run the unmutated LANE/scripts/cache_key_conformance.py and print as its last line `verdict=survived rc=0` only when the gate's own conformance run passes; (b) for `M<nn>` apply that mutant to the gate in a temp dir and run the same check, printing `verdict=killed rc=<rc>` when the mutant fails and `verdict=survived rc=0` when it passes; (c) carry at least 20 mutants, each named `M01`..`Mnn`, in a frozen table inside the file.

(2) Run every mutant (parallelise with xargs -P 8) and write LANE/.ufo/waves/round-92/integration/mutation-tip.log with exactly one line per mutant, format `M<nn> verdict=killed|survived rc=<int>`, and LANE/.ufo/waves/round-92/integration/mutation-tip.txt whose first line is `gate_sha256=<sha256 of LANE/scripts/cache_key_conformance.py at the freeze a5640ca02c20f94a0fa03af41b977b46ae99808e> mutants=<N> killed=<K> survivors=<S> met=true` with S == N-K, N >= 20, K >= 18, followed by one line per mutant naming its mutation.

(3) Prove the runner is differential, not canned: run `--mutant base` and `--mutant M01` and show the two last lines differ, and show that the frozen counter accepts your artifacts:
  python3 -B /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-92/c92_defects.py --root <scratch clone at your committed fixture revision> --revision <that revision> --work $S/w --skip-battery
  (use a scratch clone; copy the three artifacts plus a SKILL.md registry row into it and commit there with a fixture identity).
Report every mutant whose verdict you could not determine, and do not invent a verdict for a mutant you did not run.

Deliverable: the three integration files plus `/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-92/w1/ExecMutation/{run.log,Notes.md}`.
